name: 左標誌＋右多欄連結＋分隔線＋一排小圖卡片＋滿版色帶底部列
desc: 依內容高度的頁尾，上半部左側標誌、右側數欄無小標題的連結；分隔線下方一排等寬的小圖卡片；最下方是橫跨畫面的色帶底部列，小字靠右。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。上半部左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度，兩區頂端對齊：左側約三分之一是品牌區，放標誌，右側同一行可放一個較小的次要標誌，沒有時省略；右側約三分之二是數欄並排的連結群組，每組是直向排列的文字連結，不放小標題。連結群組下方有一條橫跨內容寬度的分隔線，分隔線下方是一排等寬並排、橫跨內容寬度的卡片連結，每張卡片內是置中的小圖（完整顯示），下方是置中的短說明文字（可多行），卡片高度明顯小於上方的連結區。最下方是底部列：一條橫跨整個畫面寬、貼齊畫面左右與頁尾底緣的色帶，裡面一行小字靠右、對齊頁面內容寬度的右緣。
mobile: 仍維持左右兩區：左側的標誌與次要標誌改為上下排列；右側只保留最後一組連結群組，其他連結群組隱藏。分隔線與卡片連結列隱藏。底部列的色帶保留，一行小字改為置中。

en.name: Left logo + right multi-column links + divider + row of small-image cards + full-bleed band bottom bar
en.desc: A content-height footer with a logo on the left and several columns of heading-less links on the right; below a divider, a row of equal-width small-image cards; at the very bottom, a full-bleed band bottom bar with small text on the right.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. The upper part is split into left and right areas aligned to the page content width, with their tops aligned: the left area, about one third, is the brand block with a logo, optionally followed on the same line by a smaller secondary logo, omitted when not needed; the right area, about two thirds, holds several side-by-side columns of link groups, each group being vertically stacked text links with no group heading. Below the link groups runs a divider spanning the content width; below the divider sits a row of equal-width card links side by side spanning the content width, each card containing a centered small image (shown in full) with a short centered caption below it (may wrap to multiple lines), the cards clearly shorter than the link area above. The very bottom is the bottom bar: a band spanning the full viewport width, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport and the bottom edge of the footer, containing a line of small text aligned right to the right edge of the page content width.
en.mobile: The left and right areas remain side by side: on the left, the logo and the secondary logo stack vertically; on the right, only the last link group is kept and the other link groups are hidden. The divider and the row of card links are hidden. The bottom bar band is kept, and its line of small text becomes centered.
